en: A vintage black‑and‑white harbor scene showing a small steam-powered boat in the foreground and larger ships moored along a quayside lined with multi‑story buildings and a church with a tall spire. A bridge crosses the river in the distance. The setting appears to be an urban waterfront. The printed captions read "HALMSTAD." in the upper left and "Hamnen." in the upper right.
